name: formula_comparison
provenance: Worked example A17 (docs/ASCENSION_TRIALS_KIRO_IMPLEMENTATION_SPEC_V1_1.md §14 A17). The same Maya Spellbook under the current-candidate v2.8 (legacy) profile vs the experimental hybrid 2n-3 profile, isolating the Trials-power profile F_C(S) as the sole cause of the difference (standard scoring q(S) is unchanged). Legacy 5-card standard spell power = 8 (1.5*5 = 7.5, half-up); hybrid 5-card standard spell power = 7 (2*5-3); hybrid Enchantment table 4/8/12. Under the legacy profile Maya derives Void 14, Aether 9, Transformation 17, Enchantment 4, Wild 2; under the hybrid profile Void 11, Aether 9, Transformation 16, Enchantment 8, Wild 2. Values transcribed from source, not reverse-engineered from engine output (REQ-9.4).

expected.difference_attributed_to: F_C(S) Trials power profile; standard Recognition Points q(S) are identical under both profiles
